name: NazoNazo Benchmark
description: Benchmark saturation and training-data contamination increasingly obscure whether reported gains in large language models (LLMs) reflect genuine advances in reasoning or familiarity with recurring patterns in benchmark problems. We introduce the NazoNazo Benchmark, a renewable and extensible evaluation dataset derived from Japanese children's riddles that isolates a specific class of reasoning processes: insight-like representational restructuring and metacognitive evaluation.
